sequence_notes.choose_tier: GM sets the power level for the campaign. Determines Hero Points and Trait Cap.
sequence_notes.buy_characteristics: Spend Hero Points on Abilities, Talents, Powers, and Perks. Select Flaws (min 1, max 3 at creation). Step 2 in the rulebook.
sequence_notes.choose_gear: Pick mundane gear — anything the GM considers reasonable. No Hero Point cost for mundane gear.
sequence_notes.calculate_derived: Compute Edge, Health, and Resolve using the formulas below.
sequence_notes.finishing_touches: Narrative elements: name, description, motivation, quote, connections, details, origin.
sequence_notes.gm_review: Review character with GM for concept and rules fit.

optional_packages.name: Civilian Package
optional_packages.description: Gives 2d in all Abilities and Talents. Cannot lower any of these below the package rank.

optional_packages.name: Hero Package
optional_packages.description: Gives 3d in all Abilities and 2d in all Talents. Cannot lower any below the package rank.

optional_packages.name: Superhero Package
optional_packages.description: Gives 3d in all Abilities and Talents. Cannot lower any below the package rank.

trait_costs.perks: Varies by perk — most are flat Hero Point costs

trait_rank_limits.notes: No Trait can have a rank lower than 1d or higher than the game's Trait Cap. No Power can ever cost less than 1 Hero Point (or 1 HP per 2 ranks) regardless of Cons applied.

flaw_rules.notes: 4th, 5th, and 6th Flaws each cost 3 Hero Points. Flaws can be swapped (not added/removed) between stories without HP cost if GM approves.

edge.notes: Danger Sense, Lightning Reflexes, and Super Speed can modify Edge. Lightning Reflexes adds +6 to Edge directly.

health.foe_modifier: Foes use half the normal Health value
health.notes: avg() here means (A + B) / 2 rounded up. Use whichever pairing gives more Health.

resolve.notes: Resolve depends on how close Ability and Power ranks are to the Trait Cap. Lower ranks = more Resolve. Only Heroes have Resolve. Determination Power and certain Flaws (Plot Hooks, Conditions) grant extra starting Resolve.

advancement.spending_notes: New HP spend same as character creation. Raising a baseline Trait also raises the Power using it as baseline (e.g. raising Might raises Strike rank automatically).

trait_cap_options.floating_cap: +1d per 10 HP earned through advancement (or GM sets timing instead).

advancement.retcons: Players may completely redesign a Hero (same total HP cost) between stories with GM approval.

global_caps.notes: The Trait Cap is defined by the chosen tier. Certain Power interactions (like Growth boosting Might) can push a Trait above the cap — GMs decide whether to allow these edge cases. The Overkill and Weak Cons can allow Traits to exceed the cap by up to 3 ranks (Trait Cap >= 9d) or 6 ranks (Trait Cap >= 18d) as an optional rule.
